source.title: Mathematics Grade 8 (KICD Junior Secondary School Curriculum Design)
source.publisher: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) — mirrored via teacher.co.ke
source.notes: WebFetch reported 'unable to extract text' on this PDF but saved it locally; the Read tool then parsed the full 62-page PDF text natively and verbatim (not summarized by an intermediate model). Cover page reads 'REPUBLIC OF KENYA / MINISTRY OF EDUCATION / JUNIOR SECONDARY SCHOOL CURRICULUM DESIGN / GRADE 8 / MATHEMATICS', ISBN 978-9914-43-793-5, First Published in 2022 (a watermarked 'DRAFT' copy hosted by teacher.co.ke). KICD's own Google Drive index for the Grade 8 designs page (file ID 1ttNvzuQbHUnABVcP-TAoix8-TVmehYph) shows the official current filename as 'Mathematics Grade 8 - July 2024.pdf'. FOLLOW-UP CURRENCY CHECK (2026-08-14): a dedicated search pass for a genuinely 2024-dated mirror (kicd.ac.ke direct upload URL, guessed doyenpublishers.com URL) found nothing usable — see history below. CONFIRMED CURRENT (2026-08-14, same day): the user supplied a screenshot of the official 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB-STRANDS' table from the actual KICD 'Mathematics Grade 8 - July 2024' Google Drive file. That table lists all 5 strands and all 16 sub-strands with IDENTICAL names, in identical order, to this transcription (1.0 Numbers: Integers/Fractions/Decimals/Squares and Square Roots/Rates,Ratio,Proportions and Percentages; 2.0 Algebra: Algebraic Expressions/Linear Equations; 3.0 Measurements: Circles/Area/Money; 4.0 Geometry: Geometrical Constructions/Coordinates and graphs/Scale Drawing/Common Solids; 5.0 Data Handling and Probability: Data Presentation and Interpretation/Probability), and its per-sub-strand lesson-count column sums to exactly 150, matching KICD's official total lesson count for the subject. This is strong structural proof that the July-2024 official release did not restructure, rename, add, or remove any strand/sub-strand relative to this 2022 draft transcription — only wording within outcomes could theoretically differ, which is a low-risk residual. Confidence restored to 'high' on this basis. Lesson-count allocations from that confirmed table have been added as a 'notes' field on each sub-strand below. All 5 strands and 16 sub-strands were originally read verbatim from the 2022 draft's Table of Contents (p.iv) and each detailed strand section. The document breaks down no further than sub-strand level (no subSubStrands anywhere) — Specific Learning Outcomes are lettered a), b), c)... directly under each sub-strand, unlike Grade 9 Mathematics which sometimes broke sub-strands into named subSubStrands. PRIOR SEARCH HISTORY: kicd.ac.ke's own uploads directory was tried directly (https://kicd.ac.ke/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/GRADE.8.MATHEMATICS.pdf) but returned a 'Page not found' error (confirmed by inspecting the downloaded response, which was KICD's 404 page, not a PDF). A guessed doyenpublishers.com URL following the naming pattern used successfully for other Grade 8 subjects (Grade-8-Mathematics-Curriculum-Design.pdf) also failed to resolve to a Mathematics document — it unexpectedly served the Kiswahili Grade 8 design instead. No other 2024-dated Mathematics Grade 8 mirror was found via general web search; the confirmed structure match from the user-supplied summary table made further mirror-hunting unnecessary.
